//: What each release actually changed: "engine", "hub", or both. One tag builds both binaries, so every release ships an engine bundle and a Hub bundle whether or not either changed — which means the version number alone can't tell the Hub whether there is a new engine in it. A version NOT listed here changed both, which is the normal case and the safe default: only the exceptions need a line. Read by scripts/embed-release-notes.sh over the whole manifest on every publish, so adding a line here fixes an already-published release the next time anything ships.
